export function isInUniverse(symbol: string): boolean {
  return IC_MARKETS_UNIVERSE.has(symbol);
}

export function findUntradeableInUniverse(symbols: readonly string[]): string[] {
  return symbols.filter((s) => !IC_MARKETS_UNIVERSE.has(s));
}
